title: Compact Hom commutes with sequential homotopy colimits
statement: Let C be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with countable coproducts, and let K be a compact object [def-pc-compact-object] of C. For a sequence X_0 \to X_1 \to \cdots and a homotopy colimit X given by the distinguished triangle \bigoplus_n X_n \xrightarrow{1-\mathrm{shift}} \bigoplus_n X_n \to X \to (\bigoplus_n X_n)[1], the canonical map \varinjlim_n Hom_C(K,X_n) \to Hom_C(K,X) is bijective.
